timingAccuracy.exclusionReason: The AudioWorklet monotonic-clock probe was unavailable, lacked enough positive-step samples, or observed a 95th-percentile step above 100 microseconds; callback CPU quantiles/deadline metrics are suppressed and cannot pass a performance budget.

callbackCounts.directDroppedCountUnavailableReason: The Web Audio AudioWorklet API exposes no direct browser XRUN or dropped-callback counter; positive currentFrame gaps are reported as software-side estimates.

outputSignalSentinel.limitation: A test-only AnalyserNode read pump forces software graph rendering in headless mode; inspected windows overlap and do not establish physical output, acoustic quality, or device callback timing.

instrumentation.timingSource: AudioWorklet performance.now() when available; Date.now() fallback is marked coarse and ineligible for CPU-budget conclusions
instrumentation.processCpuMetric: synchronous per-callback JavaScript wall duration; not OS thread CPU time
instrumentation.callbackStartGaps: positive excess between observed process start times and currentFrame-derived expected sample-time intervals
instrumentation.deadlineDefinition: process callback duration greater than its actual output/input block duration at the AudioContext sample rate
instrumentation.missingCallbackDefinition: estimated from positive currentFrame discontinuities relative to the prior callback block; not a browser XRUN counter
instrumentation.sharedMemory: fixed SharedArrayBuffer histograms and counters; no per-callback postMessage or dynamic allocations in the probe hot path
instrumentation.processorRegistration: test-only registerProcessor wrapper loaded before production worklets; production process implementations are invoked unchanged
instrumentation.outputFiniteProbe: test-only final-bus pass-through with a 5ms AnalyserNode read pump; main-thread inspected windows overlap and add scheduling overhead
instrumentation.outputSignalSentinel: AnalyserNode windows require finite, non-silent samples, fresh window changes, and peak level; windows overlap and are not unique output-frame counts
instrumentation.contextProgression: context must remain running and its sample clock must advance at least 95% of real measurement time, with a 1s absolute minimum
instrumentation.durationQuantization: integer microsecond histogram bins; values above 65.535 ms counted as overflow
instrumentation.measuredWrapperOverhead: wrapper histogram includes most shared-memory metric writes; it excludes its final histogram/max stores and does not estimate the total effect on browser scheduling

strictExclusions: Not a hardware test and not evidence about a physical audio interface, microphone, speakers, headphones, device drivers, or hardware buffer behavior.
The final-output sentinel proves only that the generated final bus has finite, non-silent electrical samples above the recorded threshold; it is not an acoustic or sound-quality acceptance test.
Not the complete application/runtime path: no Vue UI, device setup, recording/overdub, app transport integration, per-track production TrackAudio lifecycle, or full master/monitor topology.
Not a whole-app CPU, whole-system CPU, thermal, power, or acoustic-latency benchmark.
Not direct XRUN/dropout instrumentation. Deadline misses and frame-gap-derived missing callback estimates are software-side proxies only.
All loop and input signals are generated synthetic tones; rhythm events and kit are clean-room generated, not user audio or factory samples/MIDI.
Any result applies only to the exact headless-shell version, host, OS, graph, sample rate, duration, and instrumentation recorded in the JSON.
